title: V+A Corvara Freestanding Bath 1500x800mm
description: Victoria + Albert's white gloss freestanding bath is from their Corvara range. This range is inspired by the mountain village in the Italian Dolomites known for its clean air and stunning views. This elegantly designed, smaller freestanding bath creates a cradle-like space in which to relax. It is made of a combination of Volcanic Limestone rock and resin. It can be used on its own or in combination with the Corvara counter top basin. Disclaimer: Victoria + Albert Baths offer a colour service which allows you to personalise the exterior of your freestanding basins and baths (including the plinth and feet). Choose from the variety of available RAL colours, in either gloss or matt finish, and indicate this choice when ordering your bath or basin.

title: Duravit ME by Starck Rimless Wall Mounted Shower Seat Pan
description: Duravit's wall mounted pan is from their ME by Starck range. This rimless pan is a washdown model, uses 4.5l per flush and has a high gloss white finish. Functions of this pan include a wash function, seat heating, warm air dryer, a night light, remote control, bluetooth and remote opening and closing of the seat cover. Additional functions include odour extraction, hygiene function (activate or deactivate to flush intermittently); infrared sensory detection (lid configured to open when user approaches) and a child lock. This Duravit pan requires the Starck f Plus shower toilet seat, Durasystem cistern, A2 Flush plate and the SensoWash f Interface set and water connecting set.
